title: Domain-True Notation for Every DSL
description:
Make every derived DSL (~52 app grammars generated from the shared 🗣️dsl engine) truly represent its application domain instead of printing generic key=value structured storage. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-current-individual-dsl-distributed-manatee.md.

Progress so far this session (backfilling ticket after repo MCP was unreachable at kickoff):
- W0 (scaffold): done. dsl_core/dsl_schema/dsl_derive/dsl facade wired into nx/launch.json/test dsl.
- W1 (engine spine): done, fully verified across whole workspace. 10 new Shape variants (Quantity/Angle/Ref+defines/Coord/Dir/Dim/Range/Count/Expr/Embed) + FieldValue::Expr, wired through dsl_core (units table, Caret/DotDot/Plus/Minus/Star/Slash/Fence tokens), dsl_schema (parser/printer/type-name/rank), pack_value (shape_tag/schema_hash/wire codec — fixed a real bug: is_tuple_shape didn't recognize new tuple-shaped variants), pack_testkit, dsl_derive (#[dsl(unit/angle/refs/defines/lang/coord/dir)]). DslIdiom trait+registry added; Jack migrated onto it. dsl_token/dsl_editor deleted (zero consumers).
- W2 (pilots): 2/3 done. fem2d (Quantity on node coords/material props/section props, native units so zero solver drift, fixture regenerated, 63+ tests green). note (Embed on Math.tex, real fenced tex block, fixture regenerated, tests green). procedural3d deferred (needs RecordLayout::Call, a new printer/parser layout — judged too deep/risky to rush, documented).
- W3 (CAD+Construct): in progress. Applied #[dsl(coord)]/#[dsl(dir)] to CadVertex/CadPlaneSurface/CadObject/CadCamera fields. CAD fixture authoring + Jack-based topology query reuse (Construct = Jack applied to a CAD QueryableGraph impl, not a new parser) still pending verification — blocked intermittently by another live session's large in-progress rename across 🧰framework/🔨module/🗺️surface (paint/terrain/node-graph/tiled-map — confirmed via git status, not my work).

Two pre-existing unrelated bugs found and flagged separately (not fixed inline): stale path in renderer-react region-balance lint breaking verify gate repo-wide; invalid emoji char literals in ui_wgpu/infinite-canvas blocking anything depending on those crates.

Remaining: finish W3 (CAD fixture + Construct/Jack topology queries), W4 (family fan-out across ~25 remaining plugins — flow/dag/reasoning/process/imperative/sequence/mathematical/writer/playbook/norm/trinity/draw/lowpoly/raster/remodel/shooting/animate/architect/gis/layout/space/block/puzzle/vcs/sourcing), W5 (sweep JSON-smuggling holes + leftover fixtures), W6 (test dsl runner + verify + exhaustive/LCOV + os boot smoke).
